scope: 20 unchanged WOFF2 font binaries; separate from KaTeX JavaScript/CSS MIT license and project PolyForm Noncommercial license
method: Decoded each actual local WOFF2 via fontTools with Node.js Brotli decompression; retained name IDs 0, 13, 14; verified Git blob SHA-1 against official KaTeX v0.18.9 tree. No font binary modified.

license_text.header_origin: Copyright notices and RFNs read from actual local font nameID13; combined 12 family declarations into one notice. Official generic placeholders removed; official legal body copied unchanged after normalizing CRLF to LF.
